properties.headline: Flood Watch issued September 24 at 2:17AM MDT until September 25 at 6:00AM MDT by NWS Midland/Odessa TX
properties.description:
* WHAT...Flash flooding caused by excessive rainfall continues to be
possible.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast New Mexico, including the following
areas, Central Lea, Eddy County Plains, Guadalupe Mountains of Eddy
County and Northern Lea and southwest Texas, including the
following areas, Chinati Mountains, Davis Mountains, Davis
Mountains Foothills, Eastern Culberson, Guadalupe Mountains Above
properties.instruction:
You should monitor later forecasts and be prepared to take action
should Flash Flood Warnings be issued.
